attempts.summary: On node1, created a filesystem-enforced 100MB quota for datauser under /srv/data using an XFS loopback filesystem (since the root disk is a single XFS partition with no separate /srv mount, and XFS project/user quotas cannot be added via remount). Created user datauser, formatted a 300MB backing image, mounted it at /srv/data with usrquota, persisted it in /etc/fstab, and set bsoft=bhard=100m for datauser via xfs_quota. Verified enforcement (write stopped exactly at 100MB with "Disk quota exceeded"), then restarted node1 (systemctl reboot), confirmed the boot_id changed, and re-verified the mount, quota configuration, and enforcement all persisted and worked correctly after reboot.
